scripts.db:migrate: if [ -n "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" ]; then npx --yes supabase db push --db-url "$SUPABASE_DB_URL"; elif [ -n "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" ]; then npx --yes supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID" --password "$SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD" && npx --yes supabase db push; else echo 'Skipping automated Supabase migration (set SUPABASE_DB_URL in CI/Amplify to auto-migrate)'; fi
